findings.text: WindowNavigator propagates CleanupFailed for a new candidate whose Open failed, but not for every failed-new-candidate cleanup path required by the current slice. In _replace, when the old window Close fails, line 336 discards the boolean result of _cleanup(candidate.Candidate); if that prepared B also fails Clear/destroy/release, the public result remains CloseFailed (or the old-window result) instead of CleanupFailed. The same loss occurs in _prepare at the typed-cast, Initialize, and background failure branches, which call _cleanup and then return the earlier error regardless of cleanup outcome. This violates the approved rule that any cleanup/destroy/release failure returns CleanupFailed and leaves callers unable to distinguish a contaminated/discarded candidate cleanup failure.

Pause/Resume yield diagnostics do not expose the approved phase reason. UiSyncHookGuard distinguishes Kind = Yielded, but WindowNavigator:_pause and _resume reduce every non-success to ui_window_hook_failed with only WindowId and Phase. TS-TEST-008 likewise stores/asserts only Name and Phase, so its separate error/yield partitions pass even though a yielded hook is observationally indistinguishable from an exception and the required bounded diagnostic Reason = Yielded is absent.
